d: Replaces the Addon Manager with the Addon Marketplace: clickable filter lozenges, Update and Downgrade buttons, and a project dialog that tests web and local addon repositories. To switch it off, hide this plugin and restart Gramps.
Beta Gramplet suggesting items to research
Key in a relative of the active person, with their birth, death and other events and sources, on one form instead of working through a dozen editing dialogs

Library for other addons: phonetic surname matching (fuzzy_match_index.py), person-display formatting (fuzzy_match_display.py), and a standalone lookup window (FuzzyMatchLookupWindow.py) for a quick 'does someone like this already exist' check from another plugin. See FuzzyMatchAPI.md in this addon's own folder for the calling convention.
Gramplet for finding people in the Family Tree whose surname phonetically matches a given surname, using a cached per-tree index so it stays fast on large Family Trees
Makes Family Trees > Import... work when no Family Tree is loaded. A new Family Tree is created, named after the imported file, and the file is imported into it.
启动时，提示从 Gramps 附带的示例数据导入练习家谱。之后显示小组件页面，并附带一条帮助入门的待办事项注释。Gramps PR 2388 的插件测试版。

Improves the New/Edit Person dialogs: Multiple Surnames column widths are remembered (Gramps PR 2485), switching to Multiple Surnames adds a row ready for typing, a Fuzzy Match Lookup button appears beside the Surname field when Fuzzy Matching is installed, and the Surname field shows a 'surname' tip.
